import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source data
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Inspect columns of source0:
    # ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever',
    #  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']

    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
    # Mapping:
    # sad = average of 'sad.depressed' per user_id
    # stressed = average of 'open.stressed' per user_id

    # Convert sad.depressed and open.stressed to numeric (if not already)
    df0['sad.depressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df0['sad.depressed'], errors='coerce')
    df0['open.stressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df0['open.stressed'], errors='coerce')

    # Group by user_id and aggregate mean for sad and stressed
    agg_df0 = df0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })

    # Rename columns to target schema
    agg_df0.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)

    # Ensure correct dtypes
    agg_df0['user_id'] = agg_df0['user_id'].astype(int)
    agg_df0['sad'] = agg_df0['sad'].astype(float)
    agg_df0['stressed'] = agg_df0['stressed'].astype(float)

    # Since only one source is given, the target is just this aggregated dataframe
    target_df = agg_df0

    # Save to CSV
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
